## Checklist
- [ ] Self-tested locally
- [ ] No console errors / warnings
- [ ] Branch follows naming convention (`feature/AUTH-01-short-description`, `fix/AUTH-01-retry`, etc.)
- [ ] Synced with `develop` before opening (merge, not rebase)
- [ ] Ticket linked in the **Development** sidebar (shows the PR on the board card and moves it to In Review). If the merge closes the ticket, an Action reopens it in In Test automatically.
